- Week 2 (EU-friendly): Tue 16:00–16:45 CET / 10:00–10:45 PT / 01:00–01:45 AEST
- Week 3 (APAC-friendly): Wed 09:00–09:45 AEST / Tue 16:00–16:45 CET / Tue 08:00–08:45 PT

Option B (fixed slot + occasional rotations for critical stakeholders)
- Fixed: Tue 13:00 ET / 10:00 PT / 18:00 CET — with one in four meetings moved to an APAC slot if needed.

Attachments: I attached a short timezone-proposal.pdf and a calendar invite (.ics) with the rotating series stub.

Next step: If one of the above options looks good, reply with the times that work for your core attendees and I’ll lock the recurring invite. If not, tell us your hard constraints and we’ll re-propose.
